summary: Fractal web preserves native background job outcomes instead of assuming completion

schema.detail: No database or client-v0 schema change. The app notice schema and kit BackgroundJob.state type now also accept running, cancelled and unknown.

compatibility.detail: Existing completed and failed notices remain supported. Native failed (exit N) wording is retained, mixed job lists summarize each outcome, and legacy envelopes enrich only matching native identities and outcomes. Kit consumers must handle running, cancelled and unknown notice states.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
